# Model seats

Run `swarm(action: "models")` before Step 3 to inspect available models and remaining quotas. Give each seat the cheapest model that meets its judgment bar: top-tier reasoning for DAs, strong coding for design-and-build workers, and fast Flash-tier models for read-and-report streams and read-only research helpers.

| Role | Dispatch | Model guidance |
|---|---|---|
| Worker (design & build) | `swarm(action: "add", name: "worker-N", ...)` | Strong coding model from `swarm(action: "models")` (or omit `model` to inherit coordinator's model). Static contract in `agents/orchestrate-worker.md` uses `pro`. |
| Read-and-report worker | `swarm(action: "add", name: "worker-N", model: "<fast model>", ...)` | Fast Flash-tier model from `swarm(action: "models")` for cited-report streams with no code edits. |
| DA | `swarm(action: "add", name: "da-M", ...)` | Omit `model` to inherit the coordinator's top model, or pin a top-tier reasoning model from `swarm(action: "models")`. Static contract in `agents/adversarial-investigator.md` uses `inherit`. |
| Evidence & Step 1 helpers | `invoke_subagent(TypeName: "research-delegate", Model: "flash", ...)` | Loads `agents/research-delegate.md` directly off-board on `flash`. |

## Live model selection & quota switching

1. Call `swarm(action: "models")` (or `all: true`) to see exact accepted model IDs and live `quota_remaining`.
2. If a `waiting` worker hits quota or capacity limits, call `swarm(action: "model", name: "worker-N", model: "<alternate>")` and state why — never `kill` and re-`add` just to change models, as `model` preserves the worker's full conversation.
3. Keep `antigravity/agents/*.md` on Antigravity's static model tiers (`inherit`, `pro`, `flash`) so standalone agent and `invoke_subagent` validation always passes.
